replication.target_description: Eben et al. single replication study: retrospective surprise ratings after reward blockage; expended effort effect, 2/4, 1/3; ANOVA F test.

n.sample_role: Participants retained in final analysis; repeated-measures self-report rating ANOVAs.
n.exclusions: Ten participants excluded and replaced: two recording problems, one PsychoPy memory error, two detached electrodes, one guessing strategy, four with fewer than 7 observations in a cell after error exclusion. Practice/error/RT >500 ms/RT=0 trials and schedules with incorrect confirmation excluded for behavioral analyses; no additional rating-specific exclusions reported.

n.quote: In total 32 participants (recruited via the local Sona system from Ghent University) completed the experiment between March and July 2023 and remained in the final analysis

reported_success.location: Discussion, paragraphs on self-report replication and differing results
reported_success.quote: First, participants were more surprised by a blocked outcome when they were getting closer to the end reward, while exerted effort did not influence surprise.

notes: Both cached primary-paper titles verified against supplied references. No primary-project table URL was supplied; extracted the independently located primary papers’ Table 1 cells. Values are printed F statistics, not converted effect sizes. Original analytic n left null: enrolled sample of 27 is printed, but target-test analytic n is not explicitly established. No explicit replication-success verdict specific to the surprise/effort test was located; narrative states no effort influence, so success value is null. Replication F is printed as a bound (<0.01); retained verbatim in es.value.
